card.name: Linking words in psychiatric label text
card.fires_on: Small linking words, commas and word starts right before an expected medical term in drug-label text, often about bipolar disorder, lithium, valproate or antipsychotic reactions.

modes.label: Linking word before a risk term
modes.description: A short word such as of, to or for that comes just before a condition or reference the sentence is about to name.
modes.example: because of concern for possible induction<< of>> a mixed/manic episode in patients at

modes.label: Comma in a list of findings
modes.description: A comma after a lab finding in a list of signs.

modes.label: Space or word start in dosing and function text
modes.description: A blank space after Day or a number, or the start of a word like hepatic, in dosing lines.
modes.example: Bipolar I Disorder manic or mixed - Acute monotherapy or adjunct to lithium or divalproex - Adults Day<< >>1: 300 mg/day
